label: Gross annual income needed to afford a typical annual holiday
source: Average annual travel spend per UAE resident, AED 8,174 (Gulf News, citing a UAE travel spending survey). Corroborating scale: UAE summer holidays commonly run AED 3,000-8,000+ per person once flights, visas, hotels and transfers are counted.
note: Assumes an annual holiday costing AED 8,174 and that discretionary travel should not exceed 5% of gross income. A DERIVED figure resting on those stated assumptions, not a measured statistic, and the 5% rule is a personal-finance convention rather than an official standard. Dubai-wide: it does not vary by community, and holiday cost varies enormously by destination and party size.
method: annual holiday cost divided by the share of gross income allocated to travel
